had.songTitle: I Never Loved a Man (The Way I Love You)
had.line: How could you hurt me so bad?
stanza: Some time ago, I thought
You had run out of fools
But I was so wrong
You got one that you'll never lose
The way you treat me is a shame
How could you hurt me so bad?
Baby, you know that I'm the best thing
That you ever had

had.line: But I keep runnin' from somethin' I never wanted so bad
had.linePrev: Wish I could be the daddy that neither one of us had
had.lineNext: Sometimes I get upset, ‘cause I ain't blew up yet

partner.line: Wish I could be the daddy that neither one of us had

had.line: I know they're stolen, but I don't feel bad
stanza: Every night before I rest my head
See those dollar bills go swirling 'round my bed
I know they're stolen, but I don't feel bad
I take that money, buy you things you never had

partner.line: I take that money, buy you things you never had

stanza: The times we had
Oh, when the wind would blow with rain and snow
Were not all bad
We put our feet just where they had, had to go
Never to go
